quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 operations (annual report): the company focused on developing domestic CPU and GPU key customers and on automotive electronics, and reached 108% of its full-year strategic-customer sales target; it kept linking packaging prices to gold-wire and substrate material prices to hold margins. It completed development of ePoP/PoPt high-density memory packaging and automotive-grade FCBGA packaging for smart cockpits and autonomous driving, pushed panel-level and 2.5D platform R&D and continued CPO packaging R&D. Subsidiaries Huatian Jiangsu and Pangu Semiconductor, built for Bumping, WLP and FOPLP advanced packaging, have both entered production. 48 patents granted in 2025, 44 of them invention patents.
quarterly_data.figure: 108% of strategic-customer sales target; 48 patents (44 invention)

quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (2025 annual report): R&D spend RMB 1,037,534,018.80 (up 9.98%), 6.03% of revenue, none capitalised; 5,207 R&D staff (15.37% of employees). Projects in progress: UHDFO packaging platform (multi-chip high-integration packaging for AI chips, high-performance computing and cloud servers, aiming at volume-production capability); FOPLP panel-level packaging platform built on its WLP process; Si-interposer-based 2.5D packaging for AI, big-data and HPC products; vertical wire-bond memory packaging aiming at volume production; MEMS speaker packaging; 24mm x 24mm LQFP high-density multilayer packaging for automotive and communications.

quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): the company's 2026 operating target is full-year revenue of RMB 200 hundred million; the company states the target is not a profit forecast and depends on market demand, product prices and operating conditions, so it is uncertain.

quarterly_data.quarter: Huatian Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 work plan (annual report): focus on memory, CPU/GPU/AI, CPO and automotive-electronics markets and raise the share of advanced packaging; speed up volume production of products on the 2.5D technology platform and customer development in memory, large-size FCBGA, SiP and automotive electronics; accelerate CPO technology R&D and build a related product line for later industrialisation; continue the planned acquisition of Huayi Microelectronics to extend into power devices.
